title: Optimize RAM
name: optimize-ram
description: Purges standby memory and tunes Windows memory management to your RAM size
deepDescription:
This frees wasted standby memory and tunes the memory manager:

- Standby memory list → Purged instantly
- Kernel paging → Disabled (kernel stays in RAM)
- 8 GB or less → SysMain prefetch off (saves RAM)
- 16 GB or more → SysMain on (faster launches)

Pick your installed RAM size when applying.
